Revenue / Subscription economics

Monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

The monthly-normalized recurring subscription value at a stated snapshot date. Monthly and annual plans can be combined after normalizing their recurring amounts; one-off implementation fees are tracked separately.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The monthly-normalized recurring subscription value at a stated snapshot date. Monthly and annual plans can be combined after normalizing their recurring amounts; one-off implementation fees are tracked separately.

currency / month

How we use it

We can show new, expansion, contraction, and churned MRR movements so the team understands why the recurring revenue base changed.

Transparent calculationSum of qualifying subscription recurring amounts normalized to one month; annual recurring amount ÷ 12
monthly plan total18,000
annual plan recurring total24,000

18,000 + (24,000 ÷ 12) = 20,000 currency units of monthly recurring value.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Subscription plan and billing interval
  • Customer segment and currency
  • Recurring-revenue movement

Questions we investigate

  • Are annual plans normalized monthly?
  • Are one-off charges or taxes included accidentally?
  • Do discounts, cancellations, and currency movements reconcile?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Reconcile recurring amounts to subscription records.
  • Separate new, expansion, contraction, and churn movements.
  • Document currency and billing normalization rules.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Finance and revenue operations leads
Monthly after subscription ledger reconciliation.

Required data

  • Qualifying subscription recurring amounts
  • Billing intervals, discounts, and statuses
  • Normalization, tax, and currency policies

Read the measure with context

MRR is neither cash collected nor recognized accounting revenue. Define handling of discounts, usage charges, past-due subscriptions, and currencies. Exclude trial-only and one-time charges under this policy. Provider dashboard definitions can differ; a snapshot's MRR is not all invoices raised during that month.
